verdict.rationale: Adyen publishes an official GitHub repository of API definition files in the OpenAPI Specification standard, importable into Swagger Editor, SwaggerHub, or Postman, so a machine-readable spec is downloadable. The evidence does not show that the repo covers the in-person APIs (Terminal API or Management API), and the probe of guessed docs-site OpenAPI paths returned 404, which shows only that no spec is hosted at those paths. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that the Terminal API and Management API for in-person payments are included in the OpenAPI definitions, a discoverable spec link from the POS docs, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: This repository contains Adyen API definition files, represented in the OpenAPI Specification standard
If you prefer to use the classic Swagger toolset, upload these definitions to the [Swagger Editor](http://editor.swagger.io/) or [SwaggerHub](https://swaggerhub.com/).
we recommend you use [Postman](https://www.getpostman.com/postman) to import the API definition and create your personal collection of requests.
